name: What is the process for planning an accessible kitchen renovation with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for planning an accessible kitchen renovation with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs, preferences, and the existing space. We then develop a detailed design plan, incorporating accessibility features and material selections. Once the design is approved, we provide a transparent cost estimate and timeline. Upon agreement, our team handles all necessary permits and manages the construction phase, keeping you informed throughout the project until completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an initial consultation, design planning, detailed estimate, permit handling, and expert construction management through to completion.
